title: Diesel Heating in Zero-Emission Bus Fleets: Stochastic Planning under Winter Uncertainty: reproduction package
description: Code, inputs, archived solver results and logs reproducing every number, table and figure of 'Diesel Heating in Zero-Emission Bus Fleets: Stochastic Planning under Winter Uncertainty'. Two-stage stochastic MILP for cold-climate battery-electric bus fleet planning with fuel-fired-heater retention, EVSE-coupled preconditioning, emissions policy and division-scale coordination. This version (v2.2.0) adds the runs made after a structured peer review of the manuscript to the v9 campaign of v2.1.1: reliability re-evaluated with a shortfall-only objective at zero gap, heater capital-cost runs, a design-day benchmark, unrounded scenario weights, a re-solved fragmented division case with shared-connection re-billing, re-pricing against 24 historical winters, and a frontier built from pooled cap and carbon-price solutions. The v9 solves of v2.1.1 are unchanged.
